query: SELECT i.id, i.vessel_id, i.booking_id, i.client_name, i.status, b.client_email, v.name as vessel_name FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN bookings b ON i.booking_id = b.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON i.vessel_id = v.id WHERE i.status = 'rejected' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
